basic_info.description: Fresh off a permitted and top-of-the-line renovation this fantastic, fully detached home has been brilliantly renovated to align with market demands. A great deal of craft went into designing the home's structural plan to achieve a phenomenal open floor plan that creates an ideal communal space, anchored on one end by a cozy, tile-clad fireplace and framed by a dramatic 10-foot foldable glass wall that opens onto a walk-out deck with views of the Pacific Ocean. The stunning kitchen includes a beautiful stone waterfall island and full slab wall, custom cabinets with corner and waste bin drawers, designer lighting, and Bosch appliances. 3 full-sized bedrooms, including a large ensuite primary complement the main level of the home while downstairs hosts 2 additional bedrooms and a luxuriously-sized full bathroom. Wide plank white oak flooring runs throughout the home which has been completely rewired, and features a brand-new furnace and laundry area. Every detail has been carefully considered, from the designer tiles to the curated lighting. Set on one of the nicest blocks in Midtown Terrace this home has five bedrooms and two versatile flex rooms - perfect for in-laws, au pairs, an office, gym, hobby space, or playroom.
